description:
Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound (FLCPS) intends to solicit for NUT SELF-LOCKING:

  1. NUT, HEX HEAD SPEC:MIL-DTL-1222 TYPE I, SIZE: 5/8"-11UNC-3B, MATL: BRASS GRADE 464, BIW CATALOG NO. 53094-210
  2. WASHER, FLAT, BOLT 5/8" DIA BOLT, SPEC: FF-W-92 TY A GR I CL B, SIZE: 1-3/8" OD (1.375") X 21/32" ID (0.656") X 1/16" THK (0.062"), MATL: CRES 316
  3. SCREW, CAP, HEX, SELF-LOCKING, HEAD: HEX, SPEC: MIL-DTL-1222 TYPE 1, SIZE: 1/2"-13UNC-2A X 2" LG, BEARING SURFACE: N/A, MATL: CRES 316 ANNEALED, LOCKING ELEMENT: MIL-DTL-18240F TYPE P
  4. WASHER, ROUND, 1-1/2"OD X 21/32"ID, 0.090-0.112"THK, CRES 316, SIZE FOR 5/8"DIA BOLT. FF-W-92, TY-A, GR-1, CL-B, ANSI B18.22.1, STAMPED 316. BIW CATALOG NO. 53239-030
  5. SCREW, SELF-LOCKING: 7/8"-9UNC-2A X 2-1/4"LG, SELF-LOCKING, HEX HEAD, NICKEL COPPER ALLOY, MIL-S-1222G, TY I, GR 400, MIL-F-18240E, TYPE P BIW CAT# 53499-031
  6. NUT, SELF-LOCKING, HEX, NON-METALLIC INSERT, 250 DEG F, SPEC: NASM25027, SIZE: #10-24UNC-3B, MATL: CRES 316

All responsible sources may submit a quotation, bid, or proposal, as appropriate, which will be considered by the agency.

Quotes will be evaluated in accordance with RFO 12.203, the Government will select the most advantageous offer based on the following evaluation factors: technical including delivery date, price, and past performance in no order of relative importance. 

Drawing, references and TGIs will not be provided or furnished as part of this solicitation due to distribution restrictions.  Drawings, references and TGIs are available to quoters listed on the Joint Certification Program (JCP) website.  Quoters may request these by providing their CAGE code and DD-2345 for their data custodian.  For instructions on how to register for JCP please go to https://www.dla.mil/Logistics-Operations/Services/JCP/ .

If QPL see FAR 5.101(c)4(vii)

Anticipated Award Date: APRIL 2026
